name: Mocertatug rezetecan
sort_evidence: Mocertatug rezetecan is in five phase 3 trials in ovarian and endometrial cancer (NCT07286266 and NCT07286331 recruiting), has no FDA or EMA approval, and is a different ADC from the book's only related row, risvutatug rezetecan.
